name: arm-assembler
description: ARM plugin for Assembler code editing, local compilation and execution, and remote build/run over SSH on ARM devices such as Raspberry Pi 5

commands.title: ARM: Upload and Build on Remote Device
ARM: Upload, Build and Run on Remote Device

enumDescriptions: 64-bit ARM (A64). Raspberry Pi 3/4/5 running a 64-bit OS, Apple Silicon, ARM64 servers.
32-bit ARM (A32/Thumb). Raspberry Pi running a 32-bit OS, Cortex-A/R/M class targets.
arm-asm-builder.architecture.title: Target Architecture
arm-asm-builder.architecture.markdownDescription: Target ARM architecture. Controls the default toolchain prefix and the default user-mode emulator (`qemu-aarch64` or `qemu-arm`) used when building or running on a non-ARM host.

arm-asm-builder.toolchainPrefix.title: Toolchain Prefix
arm-asm-builder.toolchainPrefix.markdownDescription:
Prefix prepended to `as`, `ld`, `gcc` and `size`, for example `aarch64-linux-gnu-` or `arm-linux-gnueabihf-`.

Leave empty for automatic selection: no prefix when the host itself is an ARM machine, otherwise the cross prefix matching **Target Architecture**.

arm-asm-builder.assemblerPath.title: Assembler
arm-asm-builder.assemblerPath.markdownDescription: Assembler executable, combined with **Toolchain Prefix**. Use an absolute path if the toolchain is not on your system `PATH` (an absolute path is used as-is, without the prefix).

arm-asm-builder.linkerPath.title: Linker
arm-asm-builder.linkerPath.markdownDescription: Linker executable used when **Link With** is set to `ld`.

arm-asm-builder.gccPath.title: GCC Driver
arm-asm-builder.gccPath.markdownDescription: GCC driver used when **Link With** is set to `gcc`. Linking through `gcc` makes the C library available, so assembly code can call `printf`, `puts` and friends.

arm-asm-builder.sizePath.title: Size Tool
arm-asm-builder.sizePath.markdownDescription: Executable used to report section sizes of the linked binary (`size`).

arm-asm-builder.useReadelf.title: Run readelf After Size
arm-asm-builder.useReadelf.markdownDescription: If enabled, `readelf` is run on the linked binary right after `size`, and its report is written to the build output. Useful for inspecting the ELF headers, sections and symbols of the program you just assembled.

arm-asm-builder.readelfPath.title: readelf Tool
arm-asm-builder.readelfPath.markdownDescription: Executable used to inspect the linked binary, combined with **Toolchain Prefix**. Only used when **Run readelf After Size** is enabled. Use an absolute path if the toolchain is not on your system `PATH` (an absolute path is used as-is, without the prefix).

arm-asm-builder.readelfFlags.title: readelf Flags
arm-asm-builder.readelfFlags.markdownDescription: Flags passed to `readelf` before the binary name. The default `-W -h -s -S` prints the ELF header, the symbol table and the section headers in wide format.

enumDescriptions: Link through the GCC driver. The C library is available to your assembly code.
Link with ld only. Produces a freestanding binary that must use raw syscalls.
arm-asm-builder.linkWith.title: Link With
arm-asm-builder.linkWith.markdownDescription: Tool used for the link stage.

arm-asm-builder.useNoStartFiles.title: Use No Start Files
arm-asm-builder.useNoStartFiles.markdownDescription: If enabled, links with `-nostartfiles`. Recommended for pure assembly programs that provide their own entry point (`_start`) instead of `main`. Applies when **Link With** is `gcc`.

arm-asm-builder.entrySymbol.title: Entry Symbol
arm-asm-builder.entrySymbol.markdownDescription: Entry symbol passed to the linker via `-e`. Leave empty to use the linker default.

arm-asm-builder.assemblerFlags.title: Extra Assembler Flags
arm-asm-builder.assemblerFlags.markdownDescription: Additional flags passed to the assembler, for example `-g` for debug information or `-mcpu=cortex-a76`.

arm-asm-builder.linkerFlags.title: Extra Linker Flags
arm-asm-builder.linkerFlags.markdownDescription: Additional flags passed to the link stage, for example `-static` or `-lm`.

arm-asm-builder.outputDirectory.title: Output Directory
arm-asm-builder.outputDirectory.markdownDescription: Directory, relative to the workspace or source file, where generated build artifacts such as `.o` files and executables are written.

enumDescriptions: Run natively when the host is an ARM machine, otherwise run through QEMU user-mode emulation.
Always run through the QEMU user-mode emulator.
arm-asm-builder.run.useEmulator.title: Use Emulator
arm-asm-builder.run.useEmulator.markdownDescription: How locally built ARM binaries are executed on this machine.

arm-asm-builder.run.emulatorPath.title: Emulator Path
arm-asm-builder.run.emulatorPath.markdownDescription: Path or command name of the QEMU user-mode emulator. Leave empty to use `qemu-aarch64` or `qemu-arm` according to **Target Architecture**.

arm-asm-builder.run.emulatorLibraryPath.title: Emulator Library Path
arm-asm-builder.run.emulatorLibraryPath.markdownDescription: Sysroot passed to QEMU via `-L`, needed for dynamically linked binaries, for example `/usr/aarch64-linux-gnu`. Leave empty to skip.

arm-asm-builder.run.arguments.title: Program Arguments
arm-asm-builder.run.arguments.markdownDescription: Command line arguments passed to your program, both locally and on the remote device.

arm-asm-builder.run.useIntegratedTermina.title: Run in Integrated Terminal
arm-asm-builder.run.useIntegratedTermina.markdownDescription: If enabled, local runs start in a VS Code terminal instead of the output channel. Use this for programs that read from standard input; the exit code is then not reported in the output channel.

arm-asm-builder.remote.host.title: Host
arm-asm-builder.remote.host.markdownDescription: IP address or host name of the ARM device, for example `192.168.1.50` or `raspberrypi.local`.

arm-asm-builder.remote.port.title: Port
arm-asm-builder.remote.port.markdownDescription: SSH port of the remote device.

arm-asm-builder.remote.username.title: User Name
arm-asm-builder.remote.username.markdownDescription: SSH user name used to log in to the device.

arm-asm-builder.remote.password.title: Password
arm-asm-builder.remote.password.markdownDescription: SSH password. **Storing a password here writes it to `settings.json` in clear text.** Prefer leaving this empty and running **ARM: Set Remote Password**, which keeps the password in the encrypted VS Code secret storage.

arm-asm-builder.remote.workingDirectory.title: Remote Working Directory
arm-asm-builder.remote.workingDirectory.markdownDescription: Directory on the device where sources are uploaded and binaries are built. Created automatically if missing.

arm-asm-builder.remote.toolchainPrefix.title: Remote Toolchain Prefix
arm-asm-builder.remote.toolchainPrefix.markdownDescription: Prefix for the toolchain on the device. Normally empty, since a Raspberry Pi builds ARM code with its own native `as`, `ld` and `gcc`.

arm-asm-builder.remote.uploadExtraFiles.title: Extra Files to Upload
arm-asm-builder.remote.uploadExtraFiles.markdownDescription: Additional workspace-relative files uploaded next to the current source before building, for example included headers or data files.

arm-asm-builder.remote.keepFiles.title: Keep Files on Device
arm-asm-builder.remote.keepFiles.markdownDescription: If enabled, uploaded sources and built binaries stay in the remote working directory after a run. Disable to delete them once the program finishes.

arm-asm-builder.remote.connectTimeout.title: Connection Timeout (ms)
arm-asm-builder.remote.connectTimeout.markdownDescription: How long to wait for the SSH handshake before giving up.

arm-asm-builder.remote.strictHostKeyChec.title: Strict Host Key Checking
arm-asm-builder.remote.strictHostKeyChec.markdownDescription: If enabled, the fingerprint of the device is confirmed on first connection and remembered. A later fingerprint change aborts the connection. Disable only on trusted, isolated networks.
